decisions.reason: Compared with the firm's clearer lift-and-material-handling products, the construction site dumper appears less closely tied to accumulated know-how and showed weaker market signalling, so absorptive-capacity logic favors reallocating resources away from it.

The inclined furniture lift fits a coherent lifting and transport application domain in which the firm can more easily interpret user feedback and improve the product using related engineering knowledge.

The inclined building material lift is closely related to the firm's likely core competences in lifting equipment, making it easier to refine and commercialize successfully than the firm's earlier abandoned mining products.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift extends the same underlying lift technology into a plausible adjacent use case, so the firm is likely to retain it while learning from the initial market response.
